name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand with the bar across your upper back and feet beneath your hips.
Step sideways, bend the stepping knee and sit back over that hip while the other leg stays long.
Push through the bent leg to step back to center.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Keep your stepping foot flat on the floor with your knee tracking over your toes.
Keep your chest lifted and spine neutral rather than folding forward under the bar.
